review.scope: test harness process-readiness timeout and repository operations guidance only
review.assessment: The earlier unbounded communicate call is replaced with a 50ms bounded drain after a second atomic readiness-marker check. The test continues to require a finite readiness timeout, an atomic marker, and descendant termination (gone or zombie). No production implementation, dependency floor, manifest, or cleanup assertion was weakened.
